name: Android Release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      tag:
        description: Git tag for this signed APK, for example v1.0.0
        required: true
        type: string
      release_name:
        description: Visible GitHub Release title
        required: false
        type: string
      source_zip:
        description: Path to the source ZIP inside the repository (leave empty to auto-detect the only ZIP in the repo)
        required: false
        type: string
      artifact_name:
        description: Base name for the built APK/asset (defaults to the app name from pubspec.yaml)
        required: false
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  release:
    name: Build signed APK from source ZIP
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Extract one clean Flutter source tree
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          source_zip='${{ inputs.source_zip }}'
          if [ -z "$source_zip" ]; then
            mapfile -t found_zips < <(find . -maxdepth 4 -type f -iname '*.zip' -not -path '*/.git/*' | sort)
            test "${#found_zips[@]}" -ge 1 || { echo 'No ZIP file found in the repository.'; exit 1; }
            test "${#found_zips[@]}" -eq 1 || {
              echo "Multiple ZIP files found; pass source_zip explicitly:"
              printf '  %s\n' "${found_zips[@]}"
              exit 1
            }
            source_zip="${found_zips[0]#./}"
            echo "Auto-detected source ZIP: $source_zip"
          fi
          case "$source_zip" in
            ''|/*|*'..'*)
              echo 'source_zip must be a relative path inside the repository.'
              exit 1
              ;;
          esac
          test -s "$source_zip" || { echo "Missing source ZIP: $source_zip"; exit 1; }
          if unzip -Z1 "$source_zip" | grep -Eq '(^/|(^|/)\.\.(/|$))'; then
            echo 'Unsafe path found in source ZIP.'
            exit 1
          fi
          unpack_dir="$RUNNER_TEMP/source-unpacked"
          rm -rf "$unpack_dir"
          mkdir -p "$unpack_dir"
          unzip -q "$source_zip" -d "$unpack_dir"
          mapfile -t roots < <(find "$unpack_dir" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 2 -type f -name pubspec.yaml -printf '%h\n' | sort -u)
          test "${#roots[@]}" -eq 1 || {
            echo "Expected one Flutter project in source ZIP; found ${#roots[@]}."
            exit 1
          }
          app_dir="${roots[0]}"
          test -f "$app_dir/android/app/build.gradle" || { echo 'Missing Android app build configuration.'; exit 1; }

          app_name='${{ inputs.artifact_name }}'
          if [ -z "$app_name" ]; then
            app_name=$(sed -n 's/^name:[[:space:]]*//p' "$app_dir/pubspec.yaml" | head -n1 | tr -d '\r')
            test -n "$app_name" || { echo 'Could not determine app name from pubspec.yaml; pass artifact_name.'; exit 1; }
          fi

          echo "APP_DIR=$app_dir" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "APP_NAME=$app_name" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "Building from extracted source directory: $app_dir (artifact name: $app_name)"

      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '21'

      - name: Install required Android SDK components
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sdkmanager="${ANDROID_HOME:?ANDROID_HOME is not set}/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager"
          test -x "$sdkmanager" || { echo 'Android SDK command-line tools are unavailable.'; exit 1; }
          set +o pipefail
          yes | "$sdkmanager" --licenses >/dev/null
          sdkmanager_status=${PIPESTATUS[1]}
          set -o pipefail
          test "$sdkmanager_status" -eq 0 || { echo 'Android SDK license acceptance failed.'; exit 1; }
          "$sdkmanager" 'platforms;android-36' 'build-tools;36.0.0' 'ndk;28.2.13676358' 'cmake;3.22.1'

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          flutter-version: '3.35.1'
          cache: true

      - name: Fetch Flutter packages from extracted source
        working-directory: ${{ env.APP_DIR }}
        run: flutter pub get

      - name: Analyze source
        working-directory: ${{ env.APP_DIR }}
        run: flutter analyze --no-fatal-warnings --no-fatal-infos

      - name: Run nonvisual tests
        working-directory: ${{ env.APP_DIR }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -d test ]; then
            mapfile -t tests < <(find test -type f -name '*_test.dart' ! -path 'test/visual/*' | sort)
          else
            tests=()
          fi
          if [ "${#tests[@]}" -eq 0 ]; then
            echo 'No nonvisual tests were found; skipping test step.'
          else
            flutter test --no-pub "${tests[@]}"
          fi

      - name: Build signed release APK
        working-directory: ${{ env.APP_DIR }}
        run: flutter build apk --release --no-pub

      - name: Compress signed APK for download
        id: package_apk
        working-directory: ${{ env.APP_DIR }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          apk='build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk'
          test -s "$apk" || { echo 'Signed APK was not produced.'; exit 1; }
          mkdir -p release
          cp "$apk" "release/${APP_NAME}-${{ inputs.tag }}.apk"
          (
            cd release
            zip -9 -q "${APP_NAME}-${{ inputs.tag }}.apk.zip" "${APP_NAME}-${{ inputs.tag }}.apk"
          )
          asset="$PWD/release/${APP_NAME}-${{ inputs.tag }}.apk.zip"
          test -s "$asset"
          echo "asset=$asset" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Publish compressed APK to GitHub Release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ inputs.tag }}
          name: ${{ inputs.release_name || inputs.tag }}
          generate_release_notes: true
          files: ${{ steps.package_apk.outputs.asset }}
